name: Panel
description: fruithost is an OpenSource Hosting-Panel for some Linux Distributions like Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS and some other distributions!

paragraphs: # Announcement - development stop (missing donations) Since there is hardly any interest and support from the community, I am currently working on other projects. The fruithost project will not be discontinued, it will only be further developed at a later date if there is more interest. Since I am covering all development costs myself and there are no donations, we are currently unable to offer a public hosting demo. I had purchased a HomeServer for local development to make it easier to continue working on the project and switch between different Linux distributions. To date, it has not been…
